name: A live total rolls up over a glowing globe
looks: A short link pill holds at the top. Beneath it a huge number rolls up live, its last digits still ticking, above a warm, glowing dotted globe with a thin beam pinned to one point on it, as if the count is being read straight off the globe.
build: geo-pulse-globe: the digit roll-up finishes just as the beam's pulse peaks, so the two read as one live system rather than two separate elements.
sound: A low warm drone under the globe, a soft beam pulse, and a rising tone under the counting number.
prompt: Prove real-time global scale: hold a huge number rolling up live, its last digits still moving, above a glowing dotted globe with a thin beam marking one point on it, so the count and the globe read as one live system.
